quote.text: You squander time as if you drew from a full and abundant supply, though all the while that day which you bestow on some person or thing is perhaps your last.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Like the fleeting nature of time, each moment spent with your children is precious; invest your presence wholeheartedly as if each day might be the last opportunity to guide and nurture them.
    • Embrace the responsibility of parenthood by cherishing even mundane interactions, knowing that these moments build the character and virtues that will shape their future.
  • Leadership
    • Recognize that every decision and meeting is a scarce resource—lead with intention, ensuring that your time fosters growth and inspires those who follow your example.
    • Just as time is irreplaceable, so is the trust and loyalty of those you lead; invest wisely in relationships and vision to leave a lasting legacy.
  • Product Management
    • Every day offers a chance to iterate and improve; view each project moment as a singular opportunity to innovate and refine your product with care and foresight.
    • Manage your roadmap with a sense of urgency and purpose, ensuring that no moment is squandered in pursuit of value and excellence for both your team and your customers.
